title: Chapter 180
text:
After a night's rest, Kate returned the next day with a metal box. He placed the box on the coffee table and patted it lightly. "The potion is ready."

Han Xiao opened the box. Inside was a tube of thick, crimson red potion. He touched it, and a notification appeared on the interface.

Death Virus Enhancer (Low Concentration 3.5%): A potion created by a mutated virus. The essence is extracted and can be used by humans. High stability. Effect: STR + 1, DEX + 1, chance to awaken [Extraordinary Physique].

Note: Don't be fooled by its color. The taste is …

"It's only low concentration. You gave me the lowest quality potion." Han Xiao closed the box and smiled. "I'm very satisfied."

"I look forward to working with you again," Kate said politely.

"There's no need to look forward to it. I want to buy more. Do you have any stock?"

"Louis only provides long-term batches of products to large customers. If you're a single customer … especially a single customer with unknown origins, we're in a difficult position. I hope you can understand. If you can prove that you have the ability to pay for the long-term, we'll sell you the potion in batches."

Kate's face showed just the right amount of awkwardness. It was as if he wanted to agree but could only reject because of the rules. However, in the eyes of a veteran like Han Xiao, it was deliberate. He was most likely raising the price.

Han Xiao smiled mysteriously and adjusted his collar. "Let me formally introduce myself. I'm the executive officer of the Germinal Organization, Heisenberg."

Kate ate half a kilogram.

The Germinal Organization? Didn't they leave the Western Continent? Is this Heisenberg a secret executive? Or is he a liar?

"Forgive me for being blunt, but your identity is very suspicious." Kate took two steps back and reached into his pocket to grab the alarm. As long as Han Xiao made a move, he would trigger the alarm.

"Don't be nervous. Give me a moment." Han Xiao carried his backpack and walked into the toilet.

Why is he going to the toilet? Kate was confused. Just as he was confused, Han Xiao, who had changed into Viper, walked out. This high-tech mechanical suit instantly stunned Kate.

"You, you are …"

Han Xiao swung his arms and said in an electronically synthesized voice through the helmet, "This is the latest single soldier mechanical suit that the Germinal Organization has developed. If you have good eyes, you should be able to see that the technology in it is very advanced. Even the official laboratories of the Six Nations do not have this kind of technology. You don't have to worry that I am a liar. This is a secret project of the organization, so it should be able to prove my identity."

Kate opened his mouth and felt that something was wrong. "But …"

"I know what you're worried about. If you want to find the emblem of the Germinal Organization on the mechanical suit, save your energy. Times are tough now, and it's dangerous to be too high profile. I've been given full authority to handle this matter. If you want to contact the higher-ups of the organization … forgive me for being blunt, but you're not qualified yet." Han Xiao's tone was so serious that he almost believed what he said.

Kate hesitated. "I need to discuss this with the other higher-ups."

He walked to the side and turned on his tablet to contact the other higher-ups. They were all supervisors of the laboratory, and they were all surprised by Han Xiao's background.

"He can't prove his background. He can't be trusted."

"Do you want him to shout 'I am the Germinal Organization' everywhere? I don't think he needs to lie. When the deal is done, we will know if it's true or not."

"That makes sense."

"But working with the Germinal Organization seems a little dangerous …"

Han Xiao interrupted. "All our deals are confidential. If we don't say anything, no one will know. We can even sponsor you to set up a branch in Andrea."

The eyes of the higher-ups of the research institute lit up. Andrea was full of radiation, and there were many mutated animals and plants. Others avoided it like a tiger, but it was a treasure trove for them. They had heard about the generosity of the Germinal Organization, but they could not tolerate the corruption of the officials in Maple. A change of environment seemed like a good idea.

Even if they did not move the headquarters, it would be good to set up a research branch in Andrea.

"Then let's try a deal?"

"Take him to the exhibition room."

After reaching a conclusion, Kate quickly smiled and said, "We agree to the deal. Heisenberg, please follow me. I will show you the results of our research."

Han Xiao nodded. Without taking off his mechanical suit, he followed Kate into the elevator to the second basement floor.

The pharmaceutical exhibition room looked like a refrigerator door. After Kate entered the password, the door slid open automatically. Inside was a dark compound room divided into two levels. The metal stairs connected the two levels. There were glass cabinets by the wall, with different colors of drugs. The labels had their names and experimental results. There were a few finished products of each drug, labeled with different concentrations.

"These are the results of the research institute. What kind of drugs does your organization need?" Kate asked with a smile.

Han Xiao pretended to look around and said, "Every kind. Money is not a problem. It depends on whether you have enough."

The higher-ups who were watching the situation through the camera were overjoyed. This was a big order.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. "But I have to check the effects of the drugs first."

Kate opened the door of the cabinet and took out a bottle of drugs. He handed it to Han Xiao. Han Xiao looked at the information on the interface. It was a temporary buff. After drinking it, one would gain a buff, endurance + 3, for three minutes.

After confirming that the drugs in the cabinet were real, Han Xiao said, "I want a lot of them."

Kate received the order through his earpiece. He took out his laptop and opened the price page. He smiled and said, "We have enough stock. After you pay, these cute little things are all yours."

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes. "I will only pay if I see the goods with my own eyes."

"You're exaggerating. We're just a civilian organization. We wouldn't dare to offend a huge organization like yours. We won't go back on our word. I hope you can understand our concerns. Besides, your organization doesn't lack this bit of money." Kate was all smiles and his attitude was firm.

Looks like I can only lie to this extent. Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He did not plan to pay at all. He took out his gun and pointed it at Kate's forehead. He said coldly, "This is my payment."

Bang!

The tablet fell to the ground.

The threat of the gun made Kate tremble. He said, "You are a fake!"

Han Xiao did not answer. He shot at the cabinet. However, the bulletproof glass cracked and did not break.

The higher-ups in the monitoring room were shocked.

"He wants to steal our results."

"Luckily, we brought him to the exhibition room. There are safety measures there."

The metal door of the exhibition room suddenly closed and locked. The cabinet was retracted into the wall, leaving no trace. The room became empty. The ceiling moved, revealing three rows of black holes. The range of the gun covered the entire room. There was no blind spot. Han Xiao and Kate were both under the gun muzzles.

The higher-ups of the research institute said proudly.
